summary: Verified Vendoo CSV import fix. The bug was that MongoDB regex queries using {'$regex': 'sold', '$options': 'i'} weren't working with Motor 3.3.1/PyMongo 4.5.0. Fixed by adding iregex() helper function that uses Python's re.compile(pattern, re.IGNORECASE). All inventory endpoints now correctly return sold items count and financial data.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing imported Vendoo CSV data (13,224 items)
